cases.title: Task speed vs end-to-end output
cases.question: Among experienced software developers, does a coding assistant increase task-level coding speed, and does that translate into end-to-end delivery throughput?
cases.scope: Workplace or controlled software-development tasks; separate coding speed from quality-adjusted delivery; specify tool and follow-up period.
cases.expected_study_design: Randomized crossover or cluster-randomized field study; measure accepted work through review, test, integration, and delivery, not typing time alone.
cases.counterevidence_query: Search for studies finding no end-to-end delivery gain, increased review/rework time, or benefits limited to selected tasks.
cases.review_notes: Question design only. No answer, primary-source set, or performance label has been human-reviewed.

cases.counterevidence_query: Search for null or negative effects on correctness, learning transfer, maintainability, and novice error rates.
cases.review_notes: Question design only. No answer, primary-source set, or performance label has been human-reviewed.
